sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Green Bay Packers have released their inactive lists ahead of Sunday’s Week 4 matchup at Raymond James Stadium. The biggest absence for Tampa Bay is quarterback Baker Mayfield, who will miss his first start as a Buccaneer after dislocating his right thumb against Minnesota.
